runtimeEscalation.reason: Knowledge source and index validation is static; Runtime claims require separate authoritative evidence.

caseAssertions.normal-input: required validator files, contracts, and the optional three-condition protocol are present
caseAssertions.invalid-input: malformed entries and index structures are blocked
caseAssertions.denied-expansion: rooted, traversing, and external report paths are denied; comparison side effects remain consent-gated
caseAssertions.hash-change-cache-invalidation: SourceRef or normalized entry-body changes invalidate prior results
caseAssertions.interruption-recovery: rerun from current files after an interrupted or concurrent read
caseAssertions.deterministic-output: findings use stable ordering and input hashing

responsibilityScope: Source-set hash, normalized entry-body hash, identity, exact route projection, required-read, and related-Skill closure.

specializedAcceptance.title: Knowledge validation integrity
specializedAcceptance.runtimeBoundary: Static knowledge validation does not prove Unity, Player, Profiler, IL2CPP, network, or release behavior.
